point.

items.source: A dedicated Neo4j point, that is aware of its nature, either being geographic or cartesian. While you can use this interface as an attribute type in your domain class, you should not mix different type of points on the same attribute of the same label. Queries will lead to inconsistent results. Use one of the concrete implementations. See Spatial values.
items.translation: 一个专用的 Neo4j 点，它知晓自身的性质，即地理坐标或笛卡尔坐标。虽然您可以将此接口用作领域类中的属性类型，但不应在同一标签的同一属性上混合不同类型的点，否则查询将导致不一致的结果。请使用具体的实现之一。请参阅空间值。

items.source:
